name: Babel Custom Menu Links
description: Babel submodule: translate custom menu link (menu_link_content) titles and descriptions as UI strings in Babel.
project_description: Submodule of Babel. Adds a 'menu_link_content' translation-type plugin so custom menu link titles and descriptions (menu_link_content entities) appear as translatable UI strings in Babel's unified interface. Exposure can be limited to specific menus. Translations are stored back as content_translation entity translations. System-provided menu links are excluded.
